""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page by inserting the user-provided content into a predefined template. The function escapes any potentially dangerous characters in `visitor_content` to prevent script injection attacks. It then substitutes the escaped content into the template. Parameters: visitor_content (str): Content provided by the user that will be added to the HTML response. Returns: str: The resulting HTML page with the user content safely embedded. """ # Escape special HTML characters to avoid XSS vulnerabilities safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Return the final HTML string with escaped user content return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
